id: RTC-周期闹钟-外部低频晶振
title: RTC 周期闹钟（外部低频晶振）
description: The following example configures the RTC in periodic mode with a default interval of 1Hz (1s). An LED and USER_TEST pin are toggled at every interval. RTCCLK is sourced from the external low frequency crystal oscillator (LFXT). The device remains in STANDBY mode while waiting for an interrupt.（SDK 例程：rtc_periodic_alarm_lfxt_standby）
